It sounds like your hydroponic setup may need some adjustments in nutrient levels or pH balance to get those strawberries thriving again. Instead of worrying about bees, you might consider growing *basil* in your hydroponic garden since it is a wonderful plant that thrives in similar conditions and produces abundantly with very little fuss.
